card.name: Political and social-history prose, mid-list
card.fires_on: Commas, "of", "and" and similar linking words in web text about politics, labor, race and history. It is strongest at the comma in lists of social ills such as racism, sexism, nationalism.

modes.label: Commas in lists of social ills
modes.description: A comma or "and" inside a list of political or social problems.
modes.example: The U.S. labor movement has suffered from racism<<,>> sexism, and nationalism

modes.label: Linking words in political history
modes.description: Words like "of" or "represent" right before a political movement or party term.
modes.example: identify the factors that led to the rise<< of>> Populism, American expansionist policy

card.plain: It fires on small linking words and commas in essays about politics, race and history, not on medical text.
